blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The 2026 Miss Asia Pacific International pageant is bringing the vibrance of island life with the delegates partying in resort fashion to open the Grand Coronation Night. The 38 ladies took the stage in short, flowy, pastel-hued dresses by designer Vince Sityar to dance to the international pageant’s new, upbeat, theme song when they opened the show at Mactan Expo in Lapu-Lapu City, Saturday evening, Oct. 10.
